ibx_up.name: Breaks above the first hour's range (Initial Balance) after 10:15

ibx_dn.name: Breaks below the first hour's range after 10:15 (short)

va_accept_up.name: Opens above yesterday's value area and is still above it at 10:15

va_accept_dn.name: Opens below yesterday's value area and is still below it at 10:15 (short)

va_reject_up.name: Opens above yesterday's value but is back inside it at 10:15 (short, fade the open)

va_reject_dn.name: Opens below yesterday's value but is back inside it at 10:15 (long, fade the open)

vwap_reclaim.name: Closes back above session VWAP after 30+ minutes below (10:15-13:30)

vwap_loss.name: Closes back below session VWAP after 30+ minutes above (10:15-13:30, short)

names.sw_va_up: Closed above yesterday's value area (auction accepted higher)
names.sw_poc_up: Today's point of control moved above yesterday's value area
names.sw_vwap_buy: Closed above VWAP all afternoon with buyers at 55%+ of volume (delta estimate)
names.sw_ib_up: Extended above the first hour's range and closed above it
names.sw_absorb: Closed in the top third after trading below yesterday's value (sellers absorbed)
names.sw_cvd_div: Price fell on the day but estimated delta was positive (bullish divergence)
